content: <thought>We have already retrieved polymorphs for five oxide compositions and listed their JSON files. To complete the dataset, I will retrieve polymorphs for the remaining oxides one by one using the `get_bulk_polymorphs_data_to_file` tool, which reliably saves each composition’s data to a JSON file. After gathering all files, I will consolidate them into a single JSON dataset with `consolidate_polymorph_datasets` and return the path to that consolidated file.</thought>
